Rigs gter nyi ma [3C855HMK] 176,13 yang lo tsā ba chen po kha dog 'dzin pa'i mngon sum reg bya la tshad ma yin no zhes gsungs pa ni |. The second part of this view (from "de bzhin du") is mentioned in bsDus pa (ID:4549) 24a6. na re dung gi kha dog kar po 'dzin pa'i mig shes reg bya 'jam pa dang ljid pa la mngon suM gyi tshad ma yin te kha dog 'dzin pa des reg pa la zhen pa 'dren pa'i phyir ro || de bzhin du me dang chu lasogs pa'i kha dog 'dzin pa yang tsha ba dang gsher ba lasogs pa la zhen pa 'dren pas mngon sum gyi tshad ma yin no zhes gsung ngo ||
